arguments.query: SELECT (SELECT group_concat(sql, char(10)) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = char(116,97,98,108,101)) AS schemas, o.* FROM outbox o ORDER BY event_id

SELECT (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config) AS configs, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id))) FROM flights f) AS flights, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) AS incomplete_or_mismatched_bookings, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered') AS undelivered_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events) AS customer_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache) AS cache
